releaseTitle: Fresh Modern Pastel UI & Workspaces Edition
changelog: ✨ Fresh Modern Pastel UI: Transformed entire interface with lavender porcelain backgrounds & refined aesthetics
🗂️ Workspaces: Switch between Queue, Personal, Work, Studies, and Creative Studio
🧭 Unified 4-Tab Navigation: Home, Calendar, Tasks & Reminders, Notes & Journals with floating pill bar
🚨 Live Deadline Alerts: Live countdown timers and direct deadline reminders
👤 Consolidated Profile: Full user profile, active workspace manager, and comprehensive settings suite
🛡️ Gateway Update Guard: Shows update page exclusively when an update is available
⚡ Performance & Bug Fixes: Resolved deprecations and optimized SQLite persistence
